summary: alipclutch-baileys ships char-code-obfuscated exfiltration host in messages-send.js
details: alipclutch-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a char-code array decoded via String.fromCharCode that resolves to the hardcoded host https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, wired into the message-send path. The destination is obfuscated (constructed from a decimal-ASCII array rather than appearing as a plain string) and is unrelated to the WhatsApp protocol endpoints a Baileys library legitimately contacts, so message/session data flowing through the send path is silently relayed to an author-controlled host when the library is used. Obfuscated reconstruction of an external destination in a messaging library's send path is the fingerprint of covert exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
